text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a bone-chillingly cold night during the holiday season. I'm working in my office when…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho! Happy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still hard at work on this festive night? Fear not—Santa has arrived just for you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Well? Aren't you thrilled?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was I supposed to bring something?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho! Well, this year Santa's on a budget!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Just my presence alone should be heartwarming enough!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Now I must take my leave! Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little while later…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho! Happy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho! Happy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, you looked kinda lonely so I brought Mayano along!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: If I spend the holidays with an adult, I'm sure I'll start feeling mature too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we had our last holiday party at the dorm with the others…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So this year let's throw a grown-up holiday party! Which means we need to get a giant turkey!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wooow! I've seen those in the movies! Yay! Being grown-up is so cool!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okay, Trainer, you prep the turkey while we get the party jumping!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure why I'm the one entertaining Santa, but it's a wonderful and warm event regardless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little while later…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho! Happy holidays!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ho, ho, ho! Santa has many incarnations, don'tcha know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Um, so I made sure to bring gifts this time! Just wait here while I get them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio begins to line up a series of mysterious white boxes on the table.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! Here are all the presents from Teio Santa!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I made a bunch of dishes! There's something different in each box!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But just serving it up normally would be boring, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You have to eat each one in the order you open it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The truth is… I didn't have a clue what kind of present to get you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But when I saw you working in the cold, I knew exactly what you needed!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not much of a cook, but today's a special day! Hurry up and dig in while it's still warm!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Bon appetit!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Ahahaha! You opened the cake first! Looks like you're starting with dessert!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both my heart and body are warmed by Teio's surprise. I have a wonderful night.
